sources.document_title: JLCPCB news: JLCPCB Launches Transparent FPC (2025-05-08)
sources.evidence_extract: Transparent PCB made of high-transparency, high-temperature-resistant PET; up to 85% light transmittance; withstands temperatures up to 200 C; 'Fully supports surface-mount technology on transparent substrates'; ordered by selecting the Transparent option on a flex PCB order.

Rigid-flex PCBs are not yet supported. 1-Layer and 2-Layer (Transparent) PET thickness 36 um. Transparent FPC finished thickness 1-layer 0.14 mm, 2-layer 0.24 mm (excluding stiffeners). Transparent coverlay PET 25 um + adhesive 25 um. Surface finish ENIG. Copper 18/35 um single-sided, 12/18/35 um double-sided. Stiffeners: PI 0.1-0.25, FR4 0.1-1.6, stainless 0.1-0.3, tapes 3M9077/3M468/tesa8854. Bend radius >= 6x (1 layer) / 10x (multi-layer) total thickness. Hole dia 0.1-6.5 mm. Impedance control not supported.

sources.document_title: JLCPCB Help: FPC Stiffener Materials & EMI (updated 2026-10-19)
sources.evidence_extract: PI, FR-4 (hot-press bonded) and stainless-steel stiffeners with layer naming rules (pit_/pib_, fr4t_/fr4b_ ...). FR-4 stiffener 'generally used in areas with through holes or on the back of connectors'. The page does not state which stiffener types are offered for the transparent PET material.

sources.document_title: JLCPCB Help: Medium & Low Temperature Solder Paste Service (updated 2026-09-09)
sources.evidence_extract: Available for Standard PCBA orders only; surface finishes lead-free HASL or ENIG. Medium-temperature paste reflow oven 210 +/- 5 C; low-temperature paste reflow oven 180 +/- 5 C (request in PCBA remark). One paste type per order. Joints may have lower mechanical strength and darker appearance. The page does not mention flex or transparent PET boards.
